# Pixel Isolate AI Background Remover Engine — Comprehensive Technical Documentation

## Executive Overview
Pixel Isolate is a high-resolution image background removal and subject isolation application operating on client-side WebAssembly and GPU acceleration. It allows users to isolate foreground subjects from complex backgrounds, fine-tune HSV color keying parameters, perform morphological erosion and dilation, apply solid backdrop colors, and download transparent high-resolution PNG assets.

## Key Features & Technology Stack
1. **Client-Side AI Neural Segmentation**: Runs deep learning models (RMBG / Llama Scout) inside browser memory, ensuring images are processed locally without cloud server privacy leaks.
2. **Subpixel HSV Chroma Keyer**: Fine-tunes Hue, Saturation, and Value thresholds to remove solid color backdrops or green screens with zero color bleeding.
3. **Morphological Edge Filtering**: Controls edge erosion (1-5px), dilation, and Gaussian blur feathering to eliminate white print halos on dark garments.
4. **Solid Color Background Selector**: Preview and export isolated subjects with pure white (#FFFFFF), dark (#000000), or custom hex canvas backdrops.
5. **Parallel Bulk Queue Processing**: Process 50+ images simultaneously with batch zip archiving for e-commerce and print-on-demand production lines.
